<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is approximately 267.1867 Da. The isotopic distribution (M+1 ≈ 20 % of base) indicates a high carbon count (~18‑20 C). A plausible formula that matches this mass and carbon count is C₁₇H₁₉O₂, which gives a calculated monoisotopic mass of 267.1385 Da, close to the observed value within typical experimental tolerance. 

Thus, the molecular formula is: C17H19O2</thought>
<final_answer>C17H19O2</final_answer>
